coverage_comparison: Existing source_page records retained in the scope audit do not serialize these five ability tables. Full typed-ability corpus comparison remains pending; rows are literal attributed observations, not new independent entities.
provenance_warning:
These are recorded here from the fan wikis, but nobody has yet opened the
    VGO Emulator client and confirmed them. They may be exactly right, they may
    carry figures the game never used, or they may not be in the emulator at
    all — there is no way to tell from the sources alone.
    
      Of this class's 169 abilities,
      115 have had their tooltip read in game, 45 more were seen in the
      client's spellbook, and 4 were looked for and not
      found .
    
    Where a tooltip has been read it overrides the wikis, and around four in
    five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.

evidence.html: These are recorded here from the fan wikis, but nobody has yet opened the VGO Emulator client and confirmed them. They may be exactly right, they may carry figures the game never used, or they may not be in the emulator at all — there is no way to tell from the sources alone. Of this class's 169 abilities, 115 have had their tooltip read in game, 45 more were seen in the client's spellbook, and 4 were looked for and not found. Where a tooltip has been read it overrides the wikis, and around four in five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.
